title: A customer with a $0 or blank limit never gets the warning or badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30 with a credit limit of $0.00, and customer B holds Net 30 with a blank limit; each has unpaid invoices totalling $600.00 and an open work order, work order 1 and work order 2.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick customer A as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
  4. Open work order 1.
  5. Open work order 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows customer A as the customer.

Step 3:

  • No over-credit confirmation opens.
  • The New Work Order goes straight on as for any customer.

Step 4:

  • No "Over limit" badge shows.

Step 5:

  • No "Over limit" badge shows (customer B, blank limit).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S9-N1: “The warning and the badge never show when the customer's credit limit is $0 or blank.”
  • Goals: “The Over Credit warning never appears for a customer on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold, or with a $0 or blank credit limit.”
  • S11-R8: “The Over Credit warning and the "Over limit" badge stop showing for customers with a $0 or blank credit limit and for customers on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold (Story 9: Over Credit warning).”
